objective: Aim for >=95% balanced test accuracy while reducing genuine-image false positives; report measured outcomes even when target is missed.

dataset.license: CC-BY-NC-4.0; research training, weights external to git
dataset.access: Bounded seeded Dataset Viewer rows; immutable revision checked in every asset path. Viewer JPEG derivatives are not claimed to match original source image_sha256.
dataset.source_balance: Train/tuning/calibration/ID real quotas equally LAION and Pexels; OOD real quotas equally DOCCI and ImageNet. Fake model caps force >=8 train generators and >=4 OOD models.
dataset.separation: Official upstream train/validation/test boundaries retained; prompt groups, source hashes, encoded/decoded content and near-duplicate hashes checked across all local splits before training.

training.architecture: PyTorch EfficientNet-B0 CNN, ImageNet initialization; frozen lower MBConv blocks, train final MBConv block, final convolution and classifier
training.cache: Two deterministic training augmentation views, original deterministic validation; prefix state/processor/data identities recorded. No test feature extraction during fitting.
training.selection: Highest tuning-validation partial ROC-AUC at max_fpr=0.05; ties: full ROC-AUC then earlier checkpoint. Test sets never used for model/epoch/hyperparameter selection.
training.resource_decision: Before any quality evaluation, measured CPU cached-upper step: ConvNeXt-Tiny0.2101sec/image vs EfficientNet-B00.02451sec/image at2threads. Select EfficientNet-B0 to permit more actual training; previousConvNeXt is retained as comparison baseline.
training.view_schedule: One cached augmentation view per source image per epoch, alternating between two views

calibration.rule: Use only independent calibration split; maximize balanced accuracy among thresholds with empirical FPR <=0.05. Include thresholds just above tied scores; record class counts and uncertainty.

final_evaluation.primary: Balanced 1024-image official OOD test subset with held-out exact generator versions and real-image sources
final_evaluation.secondary: 512-image same-distribution ID test; old CIFAKE test and fixed 3-image diagnostic are historical secondary checks only
final_evaluation.comparison: Previous CNN and selected new CNN evaluated on identical final test examples at threshold0.5 and separately calibration-selected thresholds under same FPR constraint
final_evaluation.report: Confusion matrices, accuracy/balanced accuracy, precision/recall/F1, AUC/AP, FPR with confidence interval, per-model/source results, fixed JPEG75/downscale50 stress; no selective omission of failures.
final_evaluation.target_interpretation: 95% on this sample is not a universal accuracy guarantee; a measured miss is reported as a miss.
